--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "We have measurements for parent against controlled probes. Need design strategy to score well against peers."
STRATEGY: The parent is an adaptive IPD strategy that cooperates early, retaliates against defection, and uses probabilistic forgiveness/exploitation. The trace simulates the fixed 12-strategy population and controlled probes to identify early-round weaknesses. It proposes changing the parent into a more exploitative strategy that defects early against opponents who cooperate unconditionally for the first few rounds.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent's fitness is 275. The highest in population is 275.077 (slot 5, the parent). So the parent is already the best. We need to beat it."
STRATEGY: The parent is a complex adaptive strategy that starts cooperative, retaliates or forgives based on opponent defection rates, and never defects on the last round. The trace manually simulates 12 opponents against an all-defect line to estimate round-by-round payoffs. It proposes adding endgame defection and a probing defection to exploit forgiving opponents.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent already has some forgiveness detection: it defects if opponent defected twice in a row, etc." / "Looking at parent code: - It starts C for n<=4. - If opponent never defected, it cooperates."
STRATEGY: Parent is an adaptive TFT with forgiveness thresholds based on opponent/my defection rates, starting C for n<=4 and cooperating when opponent never defected. Trace simulates adding proactive probing/exploitation: defect every 10th round while opponent has never defected, plus last-round defection, then fall back to parent's TFT logic. Change is the added periodic defection rule when opp_def == 0 and n % 10 == 0.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Thus, the parent's logic is well-tuned. Our simple exploit of periodic defection when opp_def==0 should be safe and beneficial."
STRATEGY: Parent is an adaptive TFT-style strategy that cooperates early, forgives low defection rates, and retaliates against repeated defections. The trace simulates the parent against TFT, P5, P8, P1, P2, and P6, and adds a proactive defection every 10th round when the opponent has never defected plus a final-round defection.
